title: A critical review on Li-ion transport, chemistry and structure of ceramic–polymer composite electrolytes for solid state batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00214H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sara Catherine Sand, Jennifer L. M. Rupp, Bilge Yildiz
Polymer–ceramic composite electrolytes combine beneficial properties of each phase. We review the arguments for each possible conduction mechanism, to inform improvement of the conductivity while maintaining the mechanical benefits.
